main.description: One end-to-end encrypted vault entry (login credentials, note, etc). Every field that could reveal what the entry is for lives inside `ciphertext`; the PDS and anyone reading the repo sees only opaque bytes plus a content-addressed record key.

alg.description: Symmetric cipher used to encrypt the item payload with the vault key derived from the master password.

iv.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte random nonce, unique per item, used as GCM IV. The record key is used as GCM additional authenticated data to bind ciphertext to its record.

ciphertext.description: Base64-encoded AES-GCM ciphertext + auth tag of the JSON-encoded item payload: { title, username, password, url, notes }.
